1.name: Delivery Events
1.description: One row per delivery event (shipment milestone, exception, or status update) captured in the WMS. Tracks delays, costs, SLA breaches, and resolution outcomes.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the delivery event

fields.name: shipment_id
fields.description: FK to the parent shipment

fields.name: freight_order_id
fields.description: FK to the freight order

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Name of the carrier executing the delivery

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Type of delivery event (pickup, in-transit, delivered, exception, etc.)

fields.name: exception_category
fields.description: Category of exception if applicable (damage, delay, lost, etc.)

fields.name: location_city
fields.description: City where the event occurred

fields.name: location_country
fields.description: Country where the event occurred

fields.name: region
fields.description: Geographic region of the event

fields.name: transport_mode
fields.description: Mode of transport (air, sea, road, rail)

fields.name: is_exception
fields.description: Whether this event is an exception (Y/N)

fields.name: delay_hours
fields.description: Total hours of delay associated with this event

fields.name: delay_cost_usd
fields.description: Cost incurred due to delay in USD

fields.name: event_date
fields.description: Date the delivery event occurred

fields.name: resolution_hours
fields.description: Hours taken to resolve the exception

fields.name: root_cause
fields.description: Root cause of the exception or delay

fields.name: impact_level
fields.description: Severity / impact level of the event (low, medium, high)

fields.name: escalated
fields.description: Whether the event was escalated (Y/N)

fields.name: sla_breached
fields.description: Whether the event caused an SLA breach (Y/N)

fields.name: shipment_value_usd
fields.description: Declared value of the shipment in USD

2.name: Vehicle Trips
2.description: One row per vehicle trip recorded in the WMS. Captures route, duration, fuel consumption, costs, emissions, and driver performance for every completed or in-progress trip.

fields.name: trip_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the trip

fields.name: vehicle_id
fields.description: FK to the vehicle used for this trip

fields.name: vehicle_type
fields.description: Type / category of vehicle (truck, van, motorbike, etc.)

fields.name: driver_id
fields.description: FK to the driver who performed the trip

fields.name: driver_name
fields.description: Full name of the driver

fields.name: freight_order_id
fields.description: FK to the associated freight order

fields.name: trip_status
fields.description: Current status of the trip (planned, in-transit, completed, cancelled)

fields.name: origin_city
fields.description: City where the trip originated

fields.name: origin_state
fields.description: State/province where the trip originated

fields.name: destination_city
fields.description: City where the trip is destined

fields.name: destination_state
fields.description: State/province of the destination

fields.name: distance_km
fields.description: Total distance of the trip in kilometres

fields.name: planned_duration_hrs
fields.description: Planned trip duration in hours

fields.name: actual_duration_hrs
fields.description: Actual trip duration in hours

fields.name: trip_date
fields.description: Date the trip commenced

fields.name: trip_cost_usd
fields.description: Total cost of the trip in USD

fields.name: fuel_type
fields.description: Type of fuel used (diesel, petrol, electric, etc.)

fields.name: litres_consumed
fields.description: Total litres of fuel consumed during the trip

fields.name: fuel_cost_usd
fields.description: Total fuel cost for the trip in USD

fields.name: co2_kg_emitted
fields.description: Total CO2 emissions for the trip in kilograms

fields.name: cost_per_km
fields.description: Cost per kilometre — unit rate, meaningful to average across trips

fields.name: revenue_per_km
fields.description: Revenue per kilometre — unit rate, meaningful to average across trips

fields.name: utilization_pct
fields.description: Vehicle utilization percentage for this trip

fields.name: idle_time_hrs
fields.description: Total idle time during the trip in hours

fields.name: incidents
fields.description: Number of incidents recorded during the trip

fields.name: driver_rating
fields.description: Driver performance rating for this trip — meaningful to average, not sum

3.name: Inventory Levels
3.description: Point-in-time snapshot of inventory quantities, values, and risk indicators per item per warehouse. Deduplicated to the latest snapshot per item-warehouse pair.
3.grain_description: One row per item per warehouse, representing the latest inventory state as of snapshot_date.

fields.name: item_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the inventory item.

fields.name: warehouse_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the warehouse.

fields.name: snapshot_date
fields.description: Date the inventory snapshot was taken.

fields.name: item_name
fields.description: Human-readable name of the inventory item.

fields.name: item_category
fields.description: Category grouping for the inventory item.

fields.name: warehouse_name
fields.description: Human-readable name of the warehouse.

fields.name: warehouse_region
fields.description: Geographic region of the warehouse.

fields.name: aging_bucket
fields.description: Age bucket indicating how long inventory has been held (e.g. 0-30 days).

fields.name: stockout_risk
fields.description: Categorical risk level for stockout (Low / Medium / High / Critical).

fields.name: is_below_reorder
fields.description: Whether current quantity is below the reorder point (True/False string).

fields.name: is_below_safety_stock
fields.description: Whether current quantity is below safety stock threshold (True/False string).

fields.name: slow_moving_flag
fields.description: Indicates if the item is classified as slow-moving (True/False string).

fields.name: quantity_on_hand
fields.description: Total units physically present in the warehouse.

fields.name: quantity_reserved
fields.description: Units reserved against open orders.

fields.name: quantity_available
fields.description: Units available for new demand (on_hand minus reserved).

fields.name: reorder_point
fields.description: Threshold quantity at which a replenishment order should be triggered.

fields.name: safety_stock_qty
fields.description: Minimum buffer stock quantity maintained to guard against demand spikes.

fields.name: days_of_supply
fields.description: Estimated number of days current inventory will satisfy demand.

fields.name: avg_daily_demand
fields.description: Average daily demand units for the item.

fields.name: unit_cost_usd
fields.description: Cost per unit in USD.

fields.name: total_value_usd
fields.description: Total inventory value in USD (quantity_on_hand × unit_cost_usd).

fields.name: lead_time_days
fields.description: Supplier lead time in days for replenishment of this item.

4.name: Procurement Spend
4.description: Monthly aggregated procurement spend by supplier and spend category, including budget tracking, discounts captured, and payment status.
4.grain_description: One row per accounting period per supplier per spend category.

fields.name: period
fields.description: Accounting period in YYYY-MM format (grain key).

fields.name: supplier_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the supplier (grain key).

fields.name: spend_category
fields.description: Procurement spend category (grain key).

fields.name: month
fields.description: Calendar month name derived from the period.

fields.name: quarter
fields.description: Fiscal quarter (Q1–Q4) for the period.

fields.name: supplier_name
fields.description: Human-readable name of the supplier.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Geographic region of the supplier.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Transaction currency code (e.g. USD, EUR).

fields.name: payment_status
fields.description: Payment status for the spend record (Paid / Pending / Overdue).

fields.name: cost_center
fields.description: Internal cost center code associated with the spend.

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department that incurred the spend.

fields.name: is_strategic_spend
fields.description: Whether this spend is classified as strategic (True/False string).

fields.name: spend_amount_usd
fields.description: Total spend amount in USD for the period-supplier-category.

fields.name: po_count
fields.description: Number of purchase orders issued in the period.

fields.name: avg_po_value
fields.description: Average value per purchase order in USD.

fields.name: budget_usd
fields.description: Budgeted spend in USD for the period.

fields.name: budget_variance_pct
fields.description: Percentage variance between actual spend and budget ((actual-budget)/budget).

fields.name: discount_captured_usd
fields.description: Early-payment or negotiated discount captured in USD.

fields.name: tax_amount_usd
fields.description: Tax amount included in the spend in USD.

5.name: Suppliers
5.description: Master dimension of suppliers with performance metrics, risk ratings, and spend aggregates. One row per supplier.

fields.name: supplier_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the supplier.

fields.name: supplier_name
fields.description: Legal or trade name of the supplier.

fields.name: supplier_category
fields.description: Category of goods or services the supplier provides.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country where the supplier is headquartered.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Geographic region of the supplier.

fields.name: supplier_tier
fields.description: Supplier classification tier (Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3).

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the supplier relationship (Active / Inactive / On Hold).

fields.name: is_preferred
fields.description: Whether the supplier is designated as a preferred vendor (True/False string).

fields.name: payment_terms
fields.description: Agreed payment terms (e.g. Net 30, Net 60).

fields.name: risk_score
fields.description: Categorical risk rating for the supplier (Low / Medium / High).

fields.name: last_audit_date
fields.description: Date of the most recent supplier audit.

fields.name: total_orders
fields.description: Total number of purchase orders placed with this supplier.

fields.name: on_time_delivery_rate
fields.description: Percentage of orders delivered on time.

fields.name: quality_acceptance_rate
fields.description: Percentage of deliveries accepted without quality rejection.

fields.name: avg_lead_time_days
fields.description: Average lead time in days across all orders for this supplier.

fields.name: total_spend_usd
fields.description: Cumulative spend with this supplier in USD.

fields.name: defect_rate
fields.description: Percentage of units received with defects.

fields.name: return_rate
fields.description: Percentage of units returned to the supplier.

fields.name: avg_po_value_usd
fields.description: Average purchase order value in USD for this supplier.

fields.name: yoy_spend_change_pct
fields.description: Year-over-year percentage change in spend with this supplier.
